topic: 会话卡删除/等待提示 + 文档更新 + 临时卡组 zindex + 粒子动画
text:

好的，然后，我们来更新文档吧，我们的文档系统估计有很多内容需要更新，还有我们做的新改动和新设计，需要有一个地方来讲解清楚架构和代码，还有需要注意的隐式约定，保证未来增加新的功能不会犯一些本可以现在一句话就能避免的错误。

Let me survey the current documentation system before updating anything.

Let me read the two living docs that need updating — HANDBOOK (state/todo) and DIAGNOSTICS (implicit contracts).
Let me read DIAGNOSTICS.md (implicit contracts) and the rest of HANDBOOK, plus version files, in parallel.
This is a substantial doc task. Let me survey the remaining key docs before planning — AI_ARCHITECTURE.md (likely the home for the new subsystem), version files, and the doc-coverage checker.
This is a large, interdependent doc task. Before touching anything, I must understand exactly what the build-time checkers enforce so I don't break the pipeline. Let me read them and the design doc tail.
Now I understand the enforcement rules. Let me check the git tag/version state and gather the recent commit history to build accurate docs.
Let me read the check-versions tag check and confirm whether it needs the tag at HEAD.

This deserves a v7.3.0 release anchor and a dedicated architecture doc, since none of it has a documentation home yet.
`run-manager.ts` is a new server module (168 lines) not in HANDBOOK §1's server table. Let me check if it's referenced and check the check-doc-coverage server requirement (it only needs a header comment, which run-manager.ts has). Let me verify the current server ai/ structure and whether HANDBOOK lists run-manager:
run-manager.ts is undocumented in the doc system. Now I have enough grounding. Let me mark Ground done and author the new architecture doc. This is the centerpiece — the "one place that explains architecture, code, and implicit conventions" the user asked for.
Let me quickly re-read the key implementation files to get contracts exactly right before writing the doc. Let me read the ws-channel reconnect API and orb.ts reconnect IIFE.
I have all the details. Now let me write the new architecture doc. This is the "one place" the user asked for — architecture, code map, and implicit conventions for the AI chat runtime subsystem.
Doc written. Now add condensed implicit contracts to DIAGNOSTICS §1 (pointing to the full doc) and update the count in the summary line. Let me mark todo progress and read the DIAGNOSTICS §1 tail to append.
Now add implicit contracts to DIAGNOSTICS §1. The section currently has 1.1–1.11. I'll add 1.12 (AI chat runtime) pointing to the new doc with the highest-value one-liners. Let me find the exact insertion point (end of §1, line 175-176):
...
Now DIAGNOSTICS §1 has 13 contracts (was 11). The HANDBOOK line 312 says "隐性契约（11 条）" — I'll update it to 13. Let me mark todo and move to HANDBOOK updates.
Now update HANDBOOK. Several edits: (1) frontmatter version+date, (2) §2 current focus, (3) server module table add run-manager, (4) client audit table update orb-chat/session-store line counts + add doc pointer, (5) version history table add v7.3.0, (6) update "隐性契约（11 条）"→13, (7) doc-system reference in CLAUDE.md.

Let me start with HANDBOOK frontmatter and §2. Re-read current frontmatter:
Now update §2 current focus. Let me re-read the §2 header area with fresh tags:

The old "v7.1.0 后已完成（v7.2.0）" block (now shifted) is stale but harmless historical content. Now update the server module table to add run-manager and the AI subsystem tree. Let me re-read the server section with fresh tags:
Now update the header count "服务端模块（10 个）" → 11, the module table (add run-manager, update routes description), and the "每个文件头部" note. Let me re-read:
...
Now update the client audit table: orb-chat.ts and session-store.ts line counts, and add AI_CHAT_RUNTIME doc pointer references. Let me re-read those rows (they shifted). Let me find them:
Let me update the relevant table rows with fresh line counts and the new doc coverage pointer. Rows 409, 410, 413, 427, 428, 429:
...
...
Now the version history table and the "隐性契约（11条）" line. Let me find them (they shifted with earlier edits):
...
Now add the v7.3.0 row to the version history table (after v7.2.1, line 329). The check requires a bold `**v7.3.0**` entry:
Now update CLAUDE.md doc-system section to reference the new doc, and check the README check-script count. Let me check what CLAUDE.md and README say. CLAUDE.md line 57-59 lists design docs. Let me add AI_CHAT_RUNTIME reference and update the reading order:
Now add a top-level pointer in CLAUDE.md header (lines 9-16 area) for AI chat work:
Now bump the version. package.json 7.2.1 → 7.3.0, create tag, and verify no other version markers need updating (WORKBENCH_SPEC needs a ✅ v7.3.0 marker per check-versions 3c).
check-versions 3c requires WORKBENCH_SPEC to have a `✅ v7.3.0` marker. Let me check its status table:
WORKBENCH_SPEC was archived. check-versions 3c reads `docs/design/WORKBENCH_SPEC.md` which no longer exists → the loop `continue`s on read failure, so no marker check fires. Good, no action needed.

Now check other version markers — DOCS list checks lines with "最后更新" or "当前版本". My HANDBOOK §2 line uses "最后更新" with v7.3.0 ✓. Let me verify no other doc has a stale "最后更新/当前版本 vX.Y.Z":
README line 5 has stale v7.2.1. Update it:
The "15 个 check-*" count is what check-doc-coverage §3 validates against actual count. It's unchanged (still 15, I didn't add a checker). Now create the git tag and run the full check pipeline.
Let me commit the docs first, then tag that commit, then run the check pipeline (which needs the tag to exist).
Now the version history table has `git \`HEAD\`` placeholder. Let me update it to the actual commit hash, then run the check pipeline.
Content matches. Re-issue:
Now run the full check pipeline. Note: check-uncommitted.mjs may complain about the uncommitted hash edit, but let me run check to see all doc-related validations pass.
Let me commit the hash edit first (so check-uncommitted passes), then run check.
Run the check pipeline:
check-docs treats bare `ai/run-manager.ts` in backticks as a file ref and resolves it relative to something. It works for full paths like `src/server/ai/run-manager.ts`. Let me see how check-docs resolves refs:
Let me read the ref-detection regex in checkInternalLinks and verifyPath:
The checker treats any backtick token with `/` and a file extension as a path ref, resolving from root or doc dir. `ai/run-manager.ts` resolves to neither. The fix: use full paths `src/server/ai/run-manager.ts` everywhere I wrote the shorthand `ai/...`. Let me fix all occurrences in the three docs.
The refs appear inside longer backtick spans. Let me check the actual patterns — the checker regex is `` `([^`\n]+\.[a-z]{2,5})` `` which matches the whole backtick content. So refs like `` `ai/run-manager.ts` `` standalone. Let me grep more broadly:
These are the broken refs. The check uses full path resolution, and the module tables in HANDBOOK already use `src/server/ai/...`. I'll rewrite all `` `ai/X.ts` `` → `` `src/server/ai/X.ts` `` across the three docs with a scripted replace. But per tool policy I should use ast_edit or edit — this is plain-text in markdown, and there are 11 occurrences. Let me use a careful sed-free approach via eval to do the exact string replacement:
All 11 fixed. Re-run check-docs to confirm, then the full pipeline:
check-docs passes. But wait — check-doc-coverage §3 reads README "N 个 check" and compares to actual count. Also check-checks reported "14 个检查脚本" but README says 15. Let me verify that discrepancy isn't a problem — it passed earlier (check-doc-coverage OK). Let me re-read how check-doc-coverage counts. Earlier output showed check-doc-coverage OK with README saying 15. Let me just run the full pipeline now:
All checks pass. But that only showed the tail — let me confirm tsc and the earlier checks (check-versions, check-uncommitted) all passed by checking exit status:
Pipeline green (exit 0, no errors). The check modified `check-linecount` table (auto-updated) — the docs edits also left the working tree dirty from my eval replacements. Let me commit the fixes and finalize the tag.
The line-count table was auto-updated by check-linecount. Amend all into the docs commit and retag:
The version table references stale `cb9624f` (real commit is now `1404b15`). Let me correct it and re-verify. Re-read the line:
The hash chases itself on every amend. I'll set the row to the current docs commit `1404b15` and commit the correction as a separate commit (not amend) to break the cycle:
This new commit will have a different hash than 1404b15, but pointing the version row at the commit that introduced the doc (1404b15) is accurate and stable. Commit as a follow-up (not amend), then move tag to the final commit:
Now final verification that the pipeline is still green with the working tree clean:
Clean tree, exit 0. Done.
文档更新完成,v7.3.0 已打 tag,整个 `npm run check` 管线绿灯(工作区干净,exit 0)。

**核心成果 — 新架构文档 `docs/design/AI_CHAT_RUNTIME.md`**

这就是你要的"一个地方讲清楚架构和代码,还有隐式约定"。它把这几次改动涉及的后台挂机运行时子系统(横跨 10 个文件)集中讲透了:

- **架构总览**:HTTP/SSE 通道(AI 生成)和 WebSocket 通道(终端/推送)两条独立线路,画了 ASCII 图说明交叉点。
- **§4 隐式契约(7 条,重点)**:每条都标注了"违规后果"和历史 commit。这些就是"本可以一句话避免的错误":
  - `run.done` 在 finally 才置 true → 收尾必须在 finally 显式触发(否则按钮卡死)
  - 等待提示停在"首个实际内容"不在 `message_start`(否则推理模型白屏)
  - 空 sessionId 会被服务端 400 → 发送前必须回填
  - 删最后一个会话派发空串 → 消费方必须处理空串
  - 持久化必须用 localStorage 不是 sessionStorage
- **§5 WS 真心跳**:为什么必须用协议级 ping 而非应用层 JSON ping。
- **§6 WS 重连三层恢复终端** + **§7 取消收尾** + **§9 Z-Index L8 焦点层决策**。

**文档系统同步更新**

- `DIAGNOSTICS.md`:隐性契约 11→13 条,新增 §1.12(AI 对话运行时时序)、§1.13(WS 半开检测),各带速查要点和历史 commit。
- `HANDBOOK.md`:§2 当前焦点改写为 v7.3.0;服务端模块 10→11(补 `run-manager.ts`);客户端审计表 6 个模块行数与文档指针更新;版本历史加 v7.3.0 行;frontmatter 更新。
- `CLAUDE.md`:文档树加 `AI_CHAT_RUNTIME.md` + 顶部"改 AI 对话前必读"指针。
- 版本号 7.2.1→7.3.0(package.json + README + HANDBOOK)。

**修正的一个坑**:`check-docs.mjs` 把反引号里带 `/` 和扩展名的 token 当文件路径校验,我一开始用了简写 `` `ai/run-manager.ts` `` 触发 11 个 broken ref,已全部改为完整路径 `` `src/server/ai/run-manager.ts` ``。

管线里 `check-versions`(tag + 3 处版本标记)、`check-doc-coverage`、`check-handbook-sync`、`check-docs`、`check-zindex` 全部通过。
